overview.description: The Xtrackers MSCI Emerging Markets Select ETF (EMCS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of emerging markets equities that meet specific ESG criteria. The index selects and weights securities through an optimization process designed to minimize the exposure to climate change risks. EMCS was launched on Dec 6, 2018 and is issued by Xtrackers.
